items.label: Heavy Motorcycle Cargo Weight Limit
items.value: Max 80 kg (重型機車載物重量不超過80公斤)

items.label: Light Motorcycle Cargo Weight Limit
items.value: Max 50 kg (輕型機車載物重量不超過50公斤)

items.label: Cargo Height Limit
items.value: Must NOT exceed rider's shoulders (裝載高度不超過駕駛人肩部)

items.label: Cargo Width Limit
items.value: Must NOT extend beyond handlebars (裝載寬度不超過把手外緣)

items.label: Cargo Rear Extension Limit
items.value: Max 0.5 meters (50 cm) beyond rear axle/seat (伸出車尾不超過半公尺)

items.label: Small Light Motorcycle Curb Weight
items.value: Max 70 kg including battery (含電池車重70公斤以下)

items.label: Motorcycle Maximum Overall Height
items.value: Max 2.5 meters from ground (總高度不超過2.5公尺)

items.label: Tire Age Recommended Service Life
items.value: Max 6 years from manufacturing date (使用年限不超過6年)

items.label: Tire Tread Depth Inspection Standard
items.value: Minimum 0.8 mm (胎紋深度不得磨損低於0.8公釐)

items.label: Brake Lever Free Play
items.value: 1 to 2 cm of free travel (煞車拉桿自由行程 1 ~ 2 公分)

items.label: Battery Terminal Maintenance
items.value: Apply Vaseline (petroleum jelly) to prevent corrosion (塗抹凡士林防腐蝕)

items.label: Exhaust Smoke Color Diagnostics
items.value: Black smoke = Incomplete combustion (Rich fuel mixture / air filter clogged)

category: ⚡ Speed Limits, Following Distances & Sign Timing

items.label: Unmarked Roads (No lane lines/centerline)
items.value: Max 40 km/h (未劃設車道線或行車分向線之道路)

items.label: Single-Lane / General Roads (with markings)
items.value: Max 50 km/h unless posted otherwise (一般市區/郊區道路)

items.label: Railway Level Crossings Speed Limit
items.value: Reduce speed below 15 km/h (通過鐵路平交道降至15公里以下)

items.label: Advance Turn Signal / Hand Signal Timing
items.value: Activate at least 30 meters before turning (轉彎前30公尺顯示方向燈)

items.label: Lateral Distance When Passing/Overtaking
items.value: Maintain at least 0.5 meters side clearance (相互間隔不得少於半公尺)

items.label: Mirror Check Scan Cycle
items.value: Check mirrors every 5 seconds; do not stare > 2 seconds (每5秒看一次後照鏡)

items.label: Consecutive Speeding Citation Criteria
items.value: At least 6 minutes apart OR passed more than 1 intersection (間隔6分鐘或經過1個路口)

items.label: Speed Camera Warning Sign Distance
items.value: General roads: 100–300m in advance; Highways: 300–1,000m (告示牌距離)

items.label: Helmet Not Worn / Not Fastened
items.value: NT$500 fine (未戴安全帽或未扣緊帽帶 處500元)

items.label: Using Handheld Phone While Riding
items.value: NT$1,000 flat fine (行駛中使用手持式行動電話 處1,000元)

items.label: Overloading Cargo / Violating Dimensions
items.value: NT$300 to NT$600 fine (機車載物超重或超寬超高 處300~600元)

items.label: Occupying Oncoming Lane to Turn Left
items.value: NT$600 to NT$1,800 fine (佔用來車道搶先左轉 處600~1,800元)

items.label: Failure to Yield to Pedestrians on Crosswalk
items.value: NT$1,200 to NT$6,000 fine + 3 demerit points (不禮讓行人)

items.label: Running a Red Light (Caught on the spot)
items.value: NT$1,800 to NT$5,400 fine + 3 demerit points (闖紅燈記3點)

items.label: Unlicensed Riding (No valid license)
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$24,000 fine + vehicle impounded on spot (無照駕駛)

items.label: Driving Car/Heavy Moto with Light License
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$12,000 fine + prohibited on spot (越級駕駛)

items.label: Car/Truck License Holder Riding Heavy Moto
items.value: NT$1,800 to NT$3,600 fine + prohibited on spot (持汽車駕照騎重機)

items.label: Aggressive Driving / Dangerous Tailgating
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$36,000 fine + 6-month plate suspension + safety training

items.label: Railway Level Crossing Violations
items.value: NT$15,000 to NT$90,000 fine + 3 demerit points (if accident: license REVOKED for life)

items.label: Evading Highway Toll Resulting in Injury
items.value: NT$3,000 to NT$6,000 fine + 6-month license suspension (逃費致死傷)

items.label: License Plate Obscured, Dirty, or Rotating Frame
items.value: NT$2,400 to NT$4,800 fine + plate confiscated/suspended (號牌不依規定懸掛)

category: 🍷 Alcohol BAC Limits, DUI Penalties & Legal Escalations

items.label: Administrative Fine Threshold
items.value: Breath BAC ≥ 0.15 mg/L (or Blood ≥ 0.03%) → NT$15,000–$90,000 + 1–2 yr license suspension

items.label: Criminal Prosecution Threshold
items.value: Breath BAC ≥ 0.25 mg/L (or Blood ≥ 0.05%) → Criminal Code 185-3 prosecution + prison

items.label: Repeat DUI Offense (within 10 years)
items.value: 2nd time: NT$90,000 + previous fine; 3rd time: previous + NT$90,000 + vehicle impounded

items.label: DUI Breathalyzer Refusal
items.value: Instant NT$180,000 fine + driver license REVOKED + vehicle impounded + safety training

items.label: DUI Passenger Liability (Aged 18+)
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$15,000 fine for passengers in the same vehicle (同車乘客連坐罰)

items.label: Owner Allowing Drunk Driver to Operate
items.value: Same monetary fine as driver + vehicle license plate suspended for 2 years

items.label: DUI Crash Causing Serious Injury or Death
items.value: Permanent driver license revocation (lifetime ban from retaking) + vehicle confiscated

items.label: Ignition Interlock Device Requirement
items.value: Required for 1 year after DUI license reinstatement; driving unequipped = NT$60,000–120,000

category: 📋 License Actions, Suspensions, Revocations & Reapplication Bans

items.label: Lending Driver's License to Another Person
items.value: 3-month driver's license suspension (吊扣駕照 3 個月)

items.label: Lending Vehicle to Unlicensed Driver
items.value: 3-month driver's license suspension for vehicle owner (吊扣駕照 3 個月)

items.label: Forged, Altered, or Counterfeit License
items.value: NT$6,000–$24,000 fine + physical license CONFISCATED immediately

items.label: Cheating / Registering Dishonestly on Exam
items.value: 5-year ban from retaking driver's license test (5年內不得考領)

items.label: Failed Motorcycle Road/Written Test
items.value: Must wait at least 7 days before retaking test (重考間隔 7 天)

items.label: Hit-and-Run without Injury (Property only)
items.value: NT$1,000–$3,000 fine + driver's license suspended for 1 to 3 months

items.label: Hit-and-Run with Injury to Others
items.value: Driver's license REVOKED + banned from reapplying for 1 to 3 years

items.label: Hit-and-Run with Serious Injury or Death
items.value: Driver's license REVOKED + PERMANENT lifetime ban from retaking test

items.label: Disqualified Physical Fitness / Medical Changes
items.value: Must voluntarily return driver's license to Motor Vehicle Office (繳回駕照)

items.label: Solid Red Line Curb (Red curb marking)
items.value: Temporary stopping and parking PROHIBITED 24 hours a day (全天24小時禁止臨時停車)

items.label: Solid Yellow Line Curb (Yellow curb marking)
items.value: No parking 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily; brief stop ≤ 3 min allowed with driver ready

items.label: Yellow Diagonal Cross Grid Lines
items.value: Prohibits all temporary stopping inside intersection/gate area (禁止臨時停車網狀線)

items.label: Distance from Fire Hydrants / Fire Station Exits
items.value: No parking or stopping within 5 meters (消防栓/消防隊出入口 5公尺內)

items.label: Distance from Intersections & Bus Stops
items.value: No stopping or parking within 10 meters (交岔路口/公車站牌 10公尺內)

items.label: Distance from Railway Level Crossings
items.value: No stopping or parking within 10 meters (鐵路平交道 10公尺內)

items.label: Direct Citation Consecutive Parking Interval
items.value: Citations may be issued every 2 hours if vehicle remains unmoved (連續舉發每2小時)

category: 🩺 Emergency Trauma First Aid & CPR Protocol

items.label: CPR Compressions-to-Breaths Ratio
items.value: 30 compressions to 2 rescue breaths (30:2) for all solo adult rescues

items.label: Chest Compression Depth (Adult)
items.value: At least 5 cm, not exceeding 6 cm (胸部按壓深度 5 ~ 6 公分)

items.label: Chest Compression Rate
items.value: 100 to 120 compressions per minute (按壓頻率每分鐘 100 ~ 120 次)

items.label: Breathing Assessment Window
items.value: Minimum 5 seconds, Maximum 10 seconds (評估呼吸 5 ~ 10 秒)

items.label: Emergency CPR Sequence (Call-Call-C-A-B-D)
items.value: 1. Call patient → 2. Call 119/AED → 3. Compressions (C) → 4. Airway (A) → 5. Breathing (B) → 6. Defibrillation (D)

items.label: Compression Hand Position
items.value: Lower half of sternum / center of chest between nipples (兩乳頭連線中央胸骨下半段)

items.label: Heimlich Maneuver Hand Placement
items.value: Slightly above the navel, well below xiphoid process (肚臍上方、劍突下方)

items.label: Trauma Victim in Shock Symptoms
items.value: Pale, cool, clammy skin with rapid weak pulse (休克面色蒼白、四肢冰冷)

items.label: Bright Red Blood Spurting Continuously
items.value: Arterial bleeding (動脈出血) → Requires direct pressure / tourniquet immediately

items.label: Unconscious Victim with Normal Breathing
items.value: Place in Recovery Position (Lateral Recumbent) to keep airway clear (復甦姿勢/側臥)

items.label: White Diamond Road Marking (菱形標線)
items.value: Pedestrian crosswalk ahead; slow down and prepare to yield (前方有行人穿越道)

items.label: Double Solid Yellow Line (雙黃實線)
items.value: Directional separation line; strictly prohibits crossing, overtaking, or U-turns

items.label: Two-Stage Left Turn (Hook Turn 兩段式左轉)
items.value: Mandatory when: 1. Inner lane marked No-Moto, or 2. Hook turn sign posted, or 3. ≥3 fast lanes

items.label: Entering Multi-Lane Road Left Turn
items.value: Must enter innermost lane after crossing; do not cut abruptly across lanes

items.label: Uncontrolled Intersection Priority
items.value: 1. Branch yields to Main (支道讓幹道) → 2. Left-turn yields to Straight (轉彎讓直行) → 3. Left vehicle yields to Right vehicle (左方車讓右方車)

items.label: Roundabout (Traffic Circle) Priority
items.value: Vehicles outside the circle MUST yield to vehicles already inside the circle

items.label: Steep Slope Meeting Rule
items.value: Downhill vehicle yields to uphill vehicle; unless downhill is already midway through

items.label: Compulsory Insurance Certificate Validity
items.value: Must have at least 30 days remaining validity for title transfer/inspection (強制險效期30日以上)

items.label: Motorcycle Over 5 Years Old Ownership Transfer
items.value: Mandatory temporary inspection before ownership transfer (出廠5年以上過戶需臨檢)

items.label: Motorcycle Temporarily Out of Service Max Period
items.value: Maximum allowed suspension period is 1 year (停駛登記最長以1年為限)

items.label: Public Traffic Violation Reporting Time Limit
items.value: Must be reported within 7 days of the violation date (民眾檢舉於違規日起7日內)

items.label: Motorcycle Stolen Fuel Fee Cutoff
items.value: Charged up to one day before the police theft report date (計徵至失竊前一日)

items.label: Exhaust Pipe Modification Standard
items.value: Must NOT alter number/position; catalytic converter and muffler MUST NOT be removed
